property_summary: The reference C allows setDAO(newDao) to change the DAO pointer only if the caller is the current DAO or the contract is not configured; consequently, once configured(), a non-current-DAO caller always reverts and DAO() remains unchanged, whereas the mutant setDAO overwrites DAO whenever !configured, so after configuring the contract and having a non-DAO caller invoke setDAO, the mutant's DAO() changes while the reference's does not.
change_summary: Replace the guard condition so that it only checks !configured, bypassing the DAO-or-unconfigured condition and allowing any unconfigured caller to reset DAO.
